title: Jeremiah Bible Quiz - Chapter 2
description: Ten questions on Jeremiah 2: Yahweh remembers Israel's first love and charges his people with forsaking the spring of living waters.

questions.text: What did Yahweh say he remembered for Jerusalem?
questions.explanation: Yahweh said, "I remember for you the kindness of your youth, the love of your weddings; how you went after me in the wilderness."

answers.text: The sins and transgressions of her fathers
The blood of the prophets she had killed
The kindness of her youth and the love of her weddings
The silver and the gold of her temple

questions.text: What was Israel to Yahweh in those days?
questions.explanation: Israel was holiness to Yahweh, the first fruits of his increase; all who devoured him would be held guilty.

answers.text: Holiness to Yahweh, the first fruits of his increase
A kingdom of priests on the mountain
A light to the nations round about
A vineyard on a fruitful hill

questions.text: By whom did the prophets prophesy?
questions.explanation: The passage says the rulers transgressed against Yahweh, and the prophets prophesied by Baal and followed things that do not profit.

answers.text: By the queen of the sky
By Molech
By the stars of heaven
By Baal

questions.text: What two evils did Yahweh say his people had committed?
questions.explanation: They had forsaken Yahweh, the spring of living waters, and cut out for themselves broken cisterns that cannot hold water.

answers.text: Serving the gods of Egypt and the gods of Assyria
Forsaking the spring of living waters and cutting out broken cisterns
Robbing the temple and defiling the altar of Yahweh
Swearing falsely and profaning the Sabbath day

questions.text: In this verse, the children of which two places have broken the crown of your head?
questions.explanation: The verse says, "The children also of Memphis and Tahpanhes have broken the crown of your head."

answers.text: Babylon and Nineveh
Tyre and Sidon
Memphis and Tahpanhes
Hamath and Arpad

questions.text: What did Yahweh say would correct his people?
questions.explanation: He said, "Your own wickedness will correct you, and your backsliding will rebuke you."

answers.text: Their own wickedness
The sword of the nations
The words of the prophets
The law of Moses

questions.text: What did the people do on every high hill and under every green tree?
questions.explanation: The verse says, "on every high hill and under every green tree you bowed yourself, playing the prostitute."

answers.text: They built altars of unhewn stone
They bowed themselves, playing the prostitute
They planted gardens for their idols
They offered up their firstborn sons

questions.text: What remains even if the people wash themselves with lye and much soap?
questions.explanation: Yahweh says, "though you wash yourself with lye, and use much soap, yet your iniquity is marked before me."

answers.text: Their garments stay stained with blood
Their hands remain unclean for the altar
The dust of the idols clings to them
Their iniquity is still marked before Yahweh

questions.text: What does the house of Israel say to wood and to stone?
questions.explanation: They tell wood, "You are my father," and a stone, "You have given birth to me," having turned their back to Yahweh.

answers.text: To wood, "You are my father," and to stone, "You have given birth to me"
To wood, "You will save us," and to stone, "Be our rock"
To wood, "Hear our prayer," and to stone, "Arise and judge"
To wood, "You are holy," and to stone, "You are our king"

questions.text: Of which land did Yahweh say Judah would be ashamed, as she was of Assyria?
questions.explanation: Yahweh said, "You will be ashamed of Egypt also, as you were ashamed of Assyria," and she would leave with her hands on her head.

answers.text: Babylon
Edom
Egypt
Kedar
